question: In the review of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles in mixed matrix membranes for wastewater, what BSA rejection and flux recovery ratio did the GO/Fe3O4/PES membrane show?
rendered: The GO/Fe3O4/PES membrane showed a high rejection against bovine serum albumin (BSA) of around 92% and a flux recovery ratio (FRR) of 87.9%.
